//: Typechecks the Vercel serverless functions under api/. The root tsconfig.json only includes "src", so without this file api/ — enroll, MBI crypto, scan-mbi, rates — shipped completely unchecked. Invoked by the root `typecheck:api` script and by the ship gate.
//module: MUST stay NodeNext. package.json sets "type": "module", so Vercel loads the compiled functions as Node ESM, where strict resolution rejects extensionless relative imports at runtime (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on cold start). NodeNext is the only setting that reproduces that rule at compile time, so a missing .js extension fails the gate instead of taking /api/enroll down. Do not switch to bundler/ESNext to silence an error — add the extension.
